newsitem.title: USA: DXP Enterprises acquires two suppliers.
newsitem.headline: DXP Enterprises acquires two suppliers.

text.p: DXP Enterprises Inc said said it has acquired privately held Pelican State Supply Co Inc and also said has acquired Strategic Supply Inc.

The aggregate consideration for the transactions consisted of approximately $5,172,442 cash, 280,428 shares of DXP common stock and notes, and assumed debt and liabilities of approximately $7,690,518. The purchase prices are subject to various adjustments.
